name: codex-session-tracker
description: Codex activity tracker with a Windows VS Code gateway, managed reversible routing, full request/response capture, and lifecycle-accurate steer diagnostics.

codexSessionTracker.codexHome.description: Optional Codex home directory. Empty uses CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.

codexSessionTracker.historyLimit.description: Maximum number of root Codex chats shown per running or non-running view in the tracker panel.

codexSessionTracker.includeNonVsCodeSess.description: Also show Codex sessions whose source is not VS Code.

codexSessionTracker.pollIntervalMs.description: How often to refresh the pinned chat status. The tracker only reads Codex files.

codexSessionTracker.rescanThreadEverySec.description: How often to rescan Codex rollout metadata for child agents and newer physical rollouts.

codexSessionTracker.treeScanLimit.description: Maximum recent rollout files inspected when resolving the selected root thread and its child agents.

codexSessionTracker.activityTailMb.description: Megabytes read from the tail of each root/child rollout for current activity and timeline details. Terminal task state is scanned separately across the full file.

codexSessionTracker.timelineLimit.description: Maximum recent activity events retained per refresh and shown in the expandable timeline.

codexSessionTracker.activeScanEverySecon.description: How often to rescan the running-chat list while the tracker panel is visible.

codexSessionTracker.codexCliPath.description: Optional path to the Codex CLI binary used for official queue delivery. Steer uses the live Codex Extension IPC owner and does not use this path. Empty auto-detects PATH or the OpenAI Codex extension bundle.

codexSessionTracker.gateway.enabled.description: Start the loopback-only Codex diagnostic gateway. Existing tracker behavior remains available if disabled.

codexSessionTracker.gateway.port.description: Loopback port for the local Codex diagnostic gateway.

codexSessionTracker.gateway.modelProxyEn.description: Enable the experimental HTTP model reverse proxy. Leave disabled unless the current Codex runtime has been explicitly configured to use this gateway.

codexSessionTracker.gateway.upstreamBase.description: Explicit upstream base URL used only by experimental Gateway model-proxy mode. Credentials are forwarded but redacted from diagnostics.

codexSessionTracker.gateway.captureConte.description: Capture proxied Codex request/response and WebSocket frame contents into local gateway diagnostics. May contain sensitive prompt, file and response data.

codexSessionTracker.gateway.captureMaxMb.description: Maximum captured content bytes per HTTP body or WebSocket frame in MiB. Transport forwarding is not truncated.

codexSessionTracker.gateway.traceMaxMb.description: Maximum size of the current local gateway JSONL trace before rotation, in MiB.
